Materials.title: Materials & packaging
Materials.intro: Everything you buy to make your products: ingredients and packaging.
Materials.name: Material name
Materials.wasteHint: The part you throw away, such as peel or spills. Leave empty if none.
Materials.spoonWeightHint: Fill this in if recipes use tbsp, tsp or glasses. For example: sugar ± 12 g, flour ± 8 g, salt ± 18 g.
Materials.emptyBody: Record the ingredients and packaging you buy. E.g. Sugar, 1 kg, Rp15,000.

Expenses.title: Operating costs
Expenses.intro: Running costs besides materials: rent, electricity, wages and more.
Expenses.name: Cost name
Expenses.oneTimeHint: One-off costs such as a promotion: choose "per year", or split it per month yourself.
Expenses.ownerSalaryHint: Also add a salary for yourself (category "Your own salary"), so the profit you see isn't misleading.
Expenses.emptyBody: E.g. stall rent Rp1,500,000 per month, electricity Rp300,000 per month.

Assets.title: Inventory
Assets.intro: Business equipment: tables, chairs, stoves, freezers. The total is used as your starting capital.
Assets.name: Item name
Assets.usefulLifeHint: Roughly how long the item lasts. E.g. 24 months for a blender, 60 months for a freezer.
Assets.depreciationHint: The value the items lose each month. Counted as a fixed cost.
Assets.emptyBody: E.g. Wooden table, 2 pieces, Rp350,000, useful life 60 months.

Composition.empty: No materials in the composition yet. Add the first one below.
Composition.noMaterials: No materials to choose from yet.
Composition.spoonWeightMissing: First fill in the weight of 1 tbsp for {material} on the <link>Materials page</link>.
Composition.channelHint: Pick one channel for packaging used only there, e.g. bubble wrap only for online orders.

Products.title: Products
Products.intro: The products you sell. Open a product to fill in its composition and price.

Products.yieldHint: How many portions or units does one batch (one recipe) make? E.g. 10 cups.
Products.targetMarginHint: Leave empty to use the store target ({pct}).

Pricing.title: Price & cost
Pricing.intro: Selling price and expected sales per channel. Cost and margin are calculated for you.
Pricing.fullCostUnknown: Full cost appears once there is a sales estimate.
Pricing.marginHint: Margin = profit as a percentage of the selling price (not markup). Full cost includes operating costs and depreciation.
Pricing.previewEmpty: Enter a selling price to see cost and margin.
Pricing.inactivePreview: This product is not on sale, so it isn't counted on the dashboard.
Pricing.noComposition: This product has no composition yet, so its material cost is Rp0. Fill in the composition first.
Pricing.calcError: A composition row uses a unit that doesn't match its material. Fix the composition so the cost can be calculated.
Pricing.competitorHint: The price of a similar product elsewhere, for comparison.
Pricing.recommendationNoOverhead: Doesn't include operating costs yet — fill in expected sales for a better estimate.
Pricing.recommendationImpossible: Commission + target margin are too high: no sensible price satisfies this. Lower the target margin or use another channel.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: Untungin helps you work out your cost of goods, prices and profit. This page explains what data we keep, why, and how you delete it.
Privacy.whoBody: Untungin is run by {name}. Questions or requests about your data: <mail>{email}</mail>.
Privacy.dataAccount: Account: your name, email and basic Google profile info (such as your profile picture), and your language choice.
Privacy.dataStore: Business data you enter: stores, materials, products, recipes, prices, sales channels, costs and equipment.
Privacy.dataRecords: Daily sales and purchases you record, stored per store and deleted with your store or account.
Privacy.dataAi: AI analyses you ask for, with the summary of your store's numbers sent for each one, and a record of your daily quota use.
Privacy.useBody: Only to run Untungin for you: calculating, saving and showing your data. We don't sell data or use it for ads.
Privacy.thirdSupabase: Supabase hosts the database and handles sign-in.
Privacy.thirdGoogle: Google is used for sign-in (Google Sign-In).
Privacy.thirdGemini: Google Gemini receives a summary of your store's numbers (store name, business type, target market, operating days, target margin, products, materials, channels, prices, estimated sales, competitor prices, costs and calculated totals such as revenue, profit and break-even) only when you press "Analyze my business". Google processes it under the Gemini API terms. If Untungin uses the free tier of the Gemini API, Google may use the data sent to improve its products, and people may review it.
Privacy.storageBody: Cookies keep you signed in and remember your language. On your device we also keep your theme, the 3D/2D chart view, and a note that the first-profit celebration has been shown. There are no ad or tracking cookies.
Privacy.locationBody: Your data is stored and processed by Supabase (Singapore region), Vercel and Google, which may be outside Indonesia. Data is kept until you delete the store or your account (AI analyses go with their store).
Privacy.deleteBody: You can delete a store or your whole account at any time in Store settings, or on the setup page if you have no store yet. Deleting the account permanently removes all your stores and data.
Privacy.rightsBody: You can see, correct and delete your data, as Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law provides. Most of it you can do in the app; for anything else, contact <mail>{email}</mail>.
